description: Providing residential facilities for Prison Officers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Due to the shortage of officers in prisons, many prison officers have to work after their regular working hours, and as such it has become essential to provide residential facilities for them. However, due to the lack of adequate residential facilities in almost all prisons, it has been found necessary to implement an expeditious programme to modernize the existing residential facilities and construct new residential facilities in places with ample space. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to improve the residential facilities for prison officers as follows on priority basis during the year 2026, was approved by the Cabinet:

Construction of two barracks in Welikada Prison.
Construction of one barrack in Anuradhapura Prison.
Modernization of barracks and improvement of sanitary facilities in all prison institutions.
